critical_code_review_comments: App.js refactor is clean: 162 lines, single-responsibility (shell state + layout), delegates rendering to ViewRouter. Props are passed correctly with all handlers wrapped in useCallback.

useGlobalAudioPlayer hook is well-encapsulated with proper cleanup (cleanupProgress + unmount effect) — addresses the previous rAF accumulation pattern. Uses native HTMLAudioElement timeupdate event which is the right call.
ViewRouter.js uses a pure switch dispatch with explicit props — easy to reason about. Default case fallbacks to StreamPage (preserved from original). No business logic crept in.

MINOR NIT: ViewRouter and App.js both import handlers but ViewRouter takes ~25 props through a single object. Consider grouping props by domain (e.g., audioProps, navProps, payloadProps) if more pages are added — current size is still manageable.

Spec referenced test_ids 'register-card', 'leaderboard-card', and 'global-player' but actual codebase uses 'battle-register-card', 'battle-leaderboard-card', and 'global-now-playing'. These names PRE-EXISTED the refactor (not caused by it) — verified via git/code search. No renames introduced by this refactor.

PRE-EXISTING (NOT a refactor regression): switch-classic-btn in StadiumStudio.js:365 has 'hidden sm:inline-flex' → hidden on mobile (<640px) viewport. Classic record mode not reachable on phone unless localStorage.pp_record_mode='classic' is set manually. Worth a follow-up: add a mobile-accessible toggle if classic mode is a supported flow on mobile.
